title: Differential compatibility of explicit tensor-Hom uncurrying
statement: For a scheme X and arbitrary unbounded module-sheaf cochain complexes P,L,M, let I(M) be the fixed functorial K-injective resolution and let phi:P -> Hom(L,I(M)) be a chain map. Extend the component schemeTensorHomUncurryComponent [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-model] over the total-tensor coproduct in each degree to get U_n. Then U_n followed by d_I(n,m) equals d_Tot(n,m) followed by U_m, for every pair of integer degrees n,m. The same module explicitly constructs the resulting chain map and proves its exact summand equation.

source.place: Tag 08DJ; sites-cohomology.tex Tags 0A90 and 0A96; online source consulted at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08DJ and /tag/0A90

proof.text:
For a signed identity f followed by postcomposition minus s times g followed by precomposition equals a followed by f1, apply the additive uncurrying equivalence and precompose with the tensor symmetry. Naturality in all three variables and braiding naturality identify the terms; sub_eq_iff_eq_add moves the signed term to the other side. This is the proved private helper uncurry_differential, implementing the component calculation of Stacks Tag 0A90 via Tag 0A5Y.

Restrict the total tensor differential to P^p tensor L^q with p+q=n. Mathlib mapBifunctor.d_eq, its two summand formulas and the standard integer cochain signs give d_P tensor identity plus (-1)^p times identity tensor d_L. The private helper tensor_total_d proves this using only the existing bifunctor totalization API.

For arbitrary projections satisfying the Hom differential formula, project the chain-map identity for phi to the (q,n+1) component and apply uncurry_differential. Test the desired total equality on coproduct summands by mapBifunctor.hom_ext; tensor_total_d and iota_mapBifunctorDesc reduce it to that transported component identity. Non-adjacent degrees vanish by both complex shape axioms. This is graded_uncurry_comm, proved for arbitrary unbounded complexes and projections.

Specialize the abstract projection calculation to the fixed Hom complex. homComplex_projections_exists supplies precisely the selected differential formula, and its chosen projections are definitionally the original projections from homComplex_exists by proof irrelevance. hom_uncurry_comm performs this specialization for any ringed site, and the public theorem applies it to the scheme and its fixed resolution. Neither K-flatness nor K-injectivity is needed for this chain-level calculation. All existing public definitions and statements are unchanged.

lean.statement: theorem schemeTensorHomUncurryGraded_comm (X : Scheme.{u}) (P L M : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ) (φ : P ⟶ homComplex (R := X.sheaf) L ((schemeHomKInjectiveResolution X).obj M)) (n m : ℤ) : schemeTensorHomUncurryGraded X P L M φ n ≫ ((schemeHomKInjectiveResolution X).obj M).d n m = (pullbackTensorTotal X P L).d n m ≫ schemeTensorHomUncurryGraded X P L M φ m
